simple.meaning: גָּנַב (gânab) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication, to deceive.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 40 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 30:33. Its contexts include family, family line, righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּנַב (H1589).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
